snippet.title: Fangstorm | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://mythwright.gg/Fangstorm-YT

You are the defense. One orc demigod against relentless goblin sieges. Fight in brutal first-person melee, unleash devastating abilities, and build kill zones. Use a deep, persistent progression system to turn yourself into a meat grinder forged by endless carnage.
